latest_cos_commentary.headline: Aloha Next plus Voyix Pay is an enterprise POS-and-payments alternative.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Aloha Next plus Voyix Pay is an enterprise POS-and-payments alternative.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: 85,000 platform sites and over 8,500 payment sites at June 30, 2026; Pizza Ranch selected Aloha Next and Voyix Pay for more than 200 restaurants. Second check: Pei Wei expanded its NCR Voyix POS agreement in May 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Track Pizza Ranch implementation and compare operational stability, service model and payments migration terms.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Pizza Ranch agreement is a selection, not a completed site rollout. Expanded agreement does not quantify live sites or rollout completion.
